data.assumption: “तमिलनाडु के Q2 के आंकड़े” को 2026 की Q2 अवधि में Tamil Nadu showrooms के successful payment amount के कुल INR minor units के रूप में लिया गया है।
data.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pa.amount_minor), 0) AS value
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = s.region_id
WHERE pa.is_test = false
  AND o.is_test = false
  AND pa.status = 'succeeded'
  AND r.name = 'Tamil Nadu'
  AND pa.currency = 'INR'
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
